data.name: Vishwam
data.gender_notes: Vishwam is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Sanskrit word 'Vishwa', Vishwam signifies the universe or all-pervading. It represents the cosmic energy that permeates everything. The name Vishwam carries the meaning “Universe, All-Pervading” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit, Hindi, etc. tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Vishwam usually hope their child will grow to embody universe, all-pervading and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of the divine presence in all beings and things.
data.etymology: Vishwam belongs to the Sanskrit, Hindi, etc. linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Universe, All-Pervading.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Vishwam total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

In Hindu mythology, Vishwam is sometimes associated with Vishnu, the preserver of the universe. The name evokes a sense of vastness, universality, and inclusivity that transcends individual identities and unites us all.

It reminds us of the interconnectedness of all things and the eternal nature of the universe. By embracing the name Vishwam, one can connect with the cosmic consciousness and tap into the infinite wisdom and power of the universe. The name serves as a constant reminder of the unity and interconnectedness of all beings and the vastness of the divine reality.

historical_references.reference: Vishwamitra, a legendary sage, is believed to have lived around 5th century BCE. He is considered one of the seven great sages of India. According to Hindu mythology, he performed a great yajna (sacrifice) to acquire the status of a Rishi with the power to create mantras that could protect his followers from harm.

Vishwamitra, a ruler of the Sunga Dynasty around 185-180 BCE, is known for his patronage of art and literature. He is particularly famous for inviting the great grammarian Panini to his court, which led to the codification of Sanskrit grammar.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name 'Vishwam' in Hinduism is often associated with the universal consciousness or the all-pervading cosmic energy. In modern times, this name is seen on various platforms that reflect the current trends of spirituality, technology, and globalization. On social media, individuals use the name as a profile name or a handle, symbolizing their deep connection with the divine and the interconnectedness of the world. Mobile applications, such as meditation apps or astrology apps, may use 'Vishwam' as a brand name to appeal to users seeking spiritual growth and knowledge. Smart home devices, like virtual assistants or meditation machines, may be named 'Vishwam' to represent their ability to connect users with the universe and provide a more immersive and holistic experience.
